historical_references.reference: Qaiser-i-Hind was the title of the Mughal Emperor, Shah Jahan (1628-1658). This name signifies the 'Shadow of India' or 'Lord of India'.

Qaiser-i-Pak was the title of Muhammad Ali Jinnah, the founder of Pakistan in 1947. Jinnah was known as the 'Quaid-i-Azam', the 'Great Leader' of Pakistan, and 'Qaiser-i-Pak' means 'Lord of Pakistan'.
